constraints.name: memory_candidate_source_kind_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK (((source_kind)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['explicit_user'::character varying, 'workflow_event'::character varying, 'artifact_approval'::character varying, 'model_extraction'::character varying, 'settings_sections'::character varying, 'learning_signal'::character varying, 'memory_correction'::character varying, 'memory_restore'::character varying, 'memory_contradiction'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: memory_candidate_version_payload_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((source_kind)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['memory_correction'::character varying, 'memory_restore'::character varying, 'memory_contradiction'::character varying])::text[])) OR (((jsonb_typeof((payload_jsonb -> 'versionProposal'::text)) = 'object'::text) AND ((payload_jsonb #>> '{versionProposal,kind}'::text[]) = ANY (ARRAY['correction'::text, 'restore'::text, 'contradiction'::text])) AND ((payload_jsonb #>> '{versionProposal,sourceItemId}'::text[]) ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'::text) AND (((payload_jsonb #>> '{versionProposal,targetItemId}'::text[]) IS NULL) OR ((payload_jsonb #>> '{versionProposal,targetItemId}'::text[]) ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'::text)) AND ((((source_kind)::text = 'memory_correction'::text) AND ((payload_jsonb #>> '{versionProposal,kind}'::text[]) = 'correction'::text)) OR (((source_kind)::text = 'memory_restore'::text) AND ((payload_jsonb #>> '{versionProposal,kind}'::text[]) = 'restore'::text)) OR (((source_kind)::text = 'memory_contradiction'::text) AND ((payload_jsonb #>> '{versionProposal,kind}'::text[]) = 'contradiction'::text)))) IS TRUE)))

index.name: mail_threads_tenant_connection_id_cover_idx
index.definition: CREATE INDEX mail_threads_tenant_connection_id_cover_idx ON public.mail_threads USING btree (tenant_id, connection_id, id) INCLUDE (client_id)
